京东方科技集团股份有限公司2027届校园招聘宣讲会
- 宁波诺丁汉大学专场 -
2027 BOE Campus Employer Presentation at UNNC
引言
Introduction
加入我们，一同探索显示技术与万物智联的未来！全球显示产业龙头企业京东方（BOE）将走进宁波诺丁汉大学，带来2027届校园招聘专属机会。你将深入了解京东方的发展布局、核心业务与人才成长体系，更有机会与企业资深从业者面对面交流。
Join us to explore the future of display technology and intelligent innovation! BOE, the global leader in the display industry, is coming to UNNC to share its 2027 campus recruitment opportunities. You will get to know BOE's development layout, core business, and career growth paths, and have the chance to communicate with our senior professionals face to face.

企业介绍
Company Profile
京东方科技集团股份有限公司（BOE）创立于 1993 年 4 月，是全球领先的科技创新企业。公司以光电融合技术赋能万物智联，构建以显示为核心，物联网创新、传感器及解决方案、MLED、智慧医工协同发展的 “1+4+N+生态链” 业务架构。        
        
            作为全球显示行业龙头，BOE 推动中国显示产业实现跨越式发展。全球每 3 台智能终端就有 1 块显示屏来自 BOE，超高清、柔性、微显示等产品方案广泛供应国内外知名品牌。
BOE Technology Group Co., Ltd. (BOE), founded in April 1993, is a world-leading tech innovator. Empowering the Internet of Everything with optoelectronic integration technologies, it runs a "1+4+N+Ecosystem" business framework centered on display, covering IoT innovation, sensors & solutions, MLED and smart healthcare.
As a global leader in display industry, BOE has fueled the leap-forward growth of China’s display sector. One in three smart terminals worldwide uses BOE displays. Its UHD, flexible and micro-display solutions are widely adopted by famous global brands.
